meta.title: Agent Browser
meta.description: Use the existing Browser tab to interact with the same web page as the agent. agent-browser is included; uses the host Chrome/Chromium in full access mode.

unavailable: Could not start the included agent-browser. Chrome or Chromium must be available on the dsh host.
command_failed: The browser action failed. Try again after the current action finishes.
stream_failed: The browser connection was lost. Reload to reconnect.
permission: This browser requires full access mode. agent-browser is included with the plugin.
connection_error: Could not connect to dsh. Reconnecting…
busy: The agent is controlling this page. Wait for its current command to finish before interacting.
